title: Recovery and risky present value check

items.prompt: In the lesson's one-period recovery-of-par model, what does a recovery rate of 40% mean if default occurs by maturity?

options.label: A recovery cash flow equal to 40% of par is paid at maturity
A recovery cash flow equal to 40% of the current market price is paid at maturity
A recovery cash flow equal to 60% of par is paid at maturity

items.explanation: Under this narrow model, recovery uses par as its base and is paid at the common maturity date.

items.prompt: A one-period claim has USD 2,000 par, a current price of USD 1,850, and a 25% recovery-of-par rate. Under the lesson model, which positive recovery cash flow is used after default?
items.explanation: Recovery is 0.25 × USD 2,000 par = USD 500; the current price is not the recovery base in this model.

items.prompt: Enter loss given default as a decimal when the recovery rate is 35% (0.35).
items.explanation: Loss given default is 1 - recovery rate = 1 - 0.35 = 0.65.

items.prompt: A recovery-of-par model pays USD 900 after default on a claim with USD 1,500 par. Enter loss given default as a decimal.
items.explanation: The recovery rate is 900 / 1,500 = 0.60, so loss given default is 1 - 0.60 = 0.40.

items.prompt: A one-period defaultable zero-coupon claim has USD 1,000 par, survival probability 0.90 to maturity, recovery-of-par rate 0.40 after default, and maturity discount factor 0.95. Both the survival payoff and any recovery are paid at maturity. What is its time-zero present value in USD?
items.explanation: The probability-weighted maturity payoff is 1,000 × [0.90 + (1 - 0.90) × 0.40] = 940. Discounting gives 0.95 × 940 = 893.

items.prompt: A one-period defaultable zero-coupon claim has USD 2,500 par, cumulative default probability 0.08, loss given default 0.55, and maturity discount factor 0.92. The recovery-of-par amount after default is paid at maturity. What is its time-zero present value in USD?
items.explanation: The probability-weighted payoff factor is 1 - 0.08 × 0.55 = 0.956. Present value is 2,500 × 0.92 × 0.956 = 2,198.80.
